content.value: Epic: jarl-card becomes multiplayer. A new first-party 'pulse' plugin gives Barkpark anonymous, CORS-open, rate-limited public event ingest + durable counters + a pollable recent feed; jarl-card posts every user strike {hue,x,y,mega}, polls the feed to render other visitors' colored lightning live, and shows the total-strikes-ever counter. Design: /papers/shared-storm. Key verified constraint: guerrilla API has NO CORS today — the plugin owns CORS on its routes only.
